modalities.evidence: Resting-state EEG (rs-EEG) is a non-invasive measure of the spontaneous electrical activity of the brain

output.population: Healthy adults across the adult lifespan, ages 20–70; 608 participants
output.summary: Resting-state EEG recorded before and after cognitive activity in healthy adults across the adult lifespan, at baseline and a five-year follow-up, provided in BIDS format under a CC0 license.
